# m.crypto.movers

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The 20 crypto pairs that gained or lost the most since the previous day's close.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.crypto.movers(direction, *, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol`
- `poll(interval, mode=dm.PollMode.APPEND)`: appends each new state of a row, identified by `Symbol` and `Updated`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `direction` | `dm.Direction.GAINERS` or `dm.Direction.LOSERS`. |
| [`on_error`](README.md#on_error) | What a bad symbol or row does in this call (`dm.ErrorPolicy`). None, the default, takes each cause from the session's `MassiveConfig.on_error`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Top Market Movers (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Currencies Basic | Not included |
| Currencies Starter | Real-time |
| Currencies Business | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. When the session's `unreadable_symbols` (`MassiveConfig.on_error`) is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, the column is absent, and such a row fails the table unless the call's own `on_error` keeps it. |
| `DayOpen` | double | The open price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. |
| `DayHigh` | double | The highest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. |
| `DayLow` | double | The lowest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. |
| `DayClose` | double | The close price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. |
| `DayVolume` | double | The trading volume of the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. |
| `DayVwap` | double | The volume weighted average price. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. |
| `Fmv` | double | Fair market value is only available on Business plans. It is our proprietary algorithm to generate a real-time, accurate, fair market value of a tradable security. For more information, contact us (https://massive.com/contact). |
| `LastTradePrice` | double | The price of the trade: the amount of the pair's second currency paid for one unit of its first (US dollars per bitcoin for X:BTCUSD). From the `lastTrade` object: The most recent trade for this ticker. |
| `LastTradeSize` | double | The size (volume) of the trade. From the `lastTrade` object: The most recent trade for this ticker. |
| `LastTradeConditions` | long[] | A list of condition codes. See Crypto Condition Codes (https://massive.com/docs/rest/crypto/market-operations/condition-codes) for what each code means. From the `lastTrade` object: The most recent trade for this ticker. |
| `LastTradeId` | String | The Trade ID which uniquely identifies a trade on the exchange that the trade happened on. From the `lastTrade` object: The most recent trade for this ticker. |
| `LastTradeParticipantTimestamp` | Instant | The millisecond accuracy timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the trade was generated at the exchange. From the `lastTrade` object: The most recent trade for this ticker. |
| `LastTradeExchange` | long | The exchange that this crypto trade happened on. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/crypto/market-operations/exchanges) for a mapping of exchanges to IDs. From the `lastTrade` object: The most recent trade for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteOpen` | double | The open price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteHigh` | double | The highest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteLow` | double | The lowest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteClose` | double | The close price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteVolume` | double | The trading volume of the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteVwap` | double | The volume weighted average price. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteTransactions` | long | The number of transactions in the aggregate window. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteWindowStart` | Instant | The Unix millisecond timestamp for the start of the aggregate window. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `PrevDayOpen` | double | The open price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker. |
| `PrevDayHigh` | double | The highest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker. |
| `PrevDayLow` | double | The lowest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker. |

| `PrevDayVwap` | double | The volume weighted average price. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker. |
| `TodaysChange` | double | The value of the change from the previous day. |
| `TodaysChangePerc` | double | The percentage change since the previous day. |
| `Updated` | Instant | The last updated timestamp. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
